helpers.name: Vlasov.dobrushin_C_choice
helpers.one_line_math: For any NNReal L, the value C = max((L : ℝ), 1) satisfies 0 < C and (L : ℝ) ≤ C. This provides the Dobrushin constant independently of whether L = 0.

helpers.name: Vlasov.convolveDiff_norm_le
helpers.one_line_math: If gradW is L-Lipschitz, then for any x : PhysSpace d and any two measures ρ σ on PhysSpace d, ‖convolveFunctionMeasure gradW ρ x - convolveFunctionMeasure gradW σ x‖ ≤ L · (wasserstein1 ρ σ).toReal. This is the key estimate: the convolution ∇W * ρ is Lipschitz in ρ with respect to the Wasserstein-1 distance, via Kantorovich-Rubinstein duality.

helpers.name: Vlasov.wasserstein1_ofReal_exp_monotone
helpers.one_line_math: For C > 0 and 0 ≤ s ≤ t, we have ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (C * s)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (C * t)). This is the monotonicity of the exponential bound in time.
helpers.proof_sketch:
apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hst (le_of_lt hC))

helpers.name: Vlasov.dobrushin_ennreal_bound
helpers.one_line_math: Given the MathlibTODO_wassersteinGronwallCoupling axiom (which provides the Gronwall-based measure-valued ODE estimate), for C = max(L,1) and any two Vlasov solutions f and g, for all t ≥ 0 we have wasserstein1 (f t) (g t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (C * t)) * wasserstein1 (f 0) (g 0).

helpers.name: Vlasov.dobrushin_package_exists
helpers.one_line_math: Package the bound and positivity of C into the existential conclusion of dobrushin: ∃ C > 0, ∀ t ≥ 0, W₁(f_t, g_t) ≤ exp(C·t) · W₁(f_0, g_0).
helpers.proof_sketch:
obtain ⟨C, hC, hCL⟩ := dobrushin_C_choice L
exact ⟨C, hC, dobrushin_ennreal_bound W gradW hgradW L hL f g hf hg hf_prob hg_prob C hC hCL⟩

axioms.name: MathlibTODO_convolveLipschitzEstimate
axioms.statement_summary: For L-Lipschitz gradW and measures ρ, σ on PhysSpace d, the pointwise norm ‖(∇W*ρ)(x) - (∇W*σ)(x)‖ is bounded by L · W₁(ρ,σ).toReal for all x.
axioms.one_line_math: The map ρ ↦ ∇W * ρ (convolution of Lipschitz function with measure) is Lipschitz in ρ with respect to Wasserstein-1 distance: ‖(∇W*ρ)(x) - (∇W*σ)(x)‖ ≤ L · W₁(ρ,σ) for all x.

axioms.name: MathlibTODO_wassersteinGronwallCoupling
axioms.statement_summary: Given two Vlasov solutions f and g with L-Lipschitz ∇W and C ≥ L, C > 0, the Gronwall inequality via characteristic flow coupling gives wasserstein1 (f t) (g t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (exp (C * t)) * wasserstein1 (f 0) (g 0) for all t ≥ 0.
axioms.one_line_math: The Gronwall inequality, applied via a coupling of the characteristic ODEs for two Vlasov solutions, yields exponential growth of W₁(f_t, g_t) with constant C ≥ L. This requires Mathlib API for measure-valued ODEs and Wasserstein-1 triangle inequality under pushforward.

residual_glue.branch_label: main body of dobrushin; residual sorry to be closed once dobrushin_package_exists is proved
residual_glue.strategy: Once dobrushin_package_exists is proved (using dobrushin_C_choice + dobrushin_ennreal_bound), the parent obtains ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ from it and packages them as the ∃ C witness.
residual_glue.tactic_sketch:
obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ :=
  dobrushin_package_exists W gradW hgradW L hL f g hf hg hf_prob hg_prob
exact ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩
